title: SarnautCore common definitions
description: Shared identifier, geometry and provenance vocabulary. This file is not a document schema: no authored YAML validates directly against it. Every document schema pulls $defs out of it so that the provenance contract is written once.

slug.description: A lowercase, hyphen-separated token with no dots.

canonicalId.description: An English canonical identifier (ADR 0007): two or more dot-separated slugs, e.g. item.junk.clockwork-feather.

zoneId.description: The canonical id of a zone document.

locKey.description: A localization key resolved through a locale document. Keys are stable strings supplied by the source localization pack, keyed to canonical ids per ADR 0007. The pattern is deliberately permissive — it only rules out empty keys and keys starting with punctuation — because the key space belongs to the source loc packs, not to this project.

sourceRoot.description: Which canonical source root (ADR 0009) supplied a value: classic-server-1-1, classic-client-1-1, modern-server-7-0, modern-client-17-0, or a demo root.

resourceRef.description: A pointer at another resource. href is the source-tree path and is always present. id is present once the extractor has mapped that path to a canonical id; a ref carrying an id is an edge in the content reference graph, a ref without one is not yet mapped.

source.description: Provenance for one authored document: where the bytes came from, what they hashed to, and which extractor produced them.

prototype_chain.description: The prototype documents that were merged, in application order, ending with this document's own id. Recorded so a resolved value can be traced back to the prototype that supplied it.

base.description: The fields every extracted document carries. Deliberately zone-free: mob kinds, loot tables, factions, locales, chargen options and abilities are global resources with no zone. Schemas whose documents are scoped to one zone add the zone field themselves.
